The selected generated configuration/source-list material is covered by the
Chromium BSD-3-Clause notice in LICENSES/chromium.txt.

Selected repository-contained source: the exact Chromium generic source and
header lists for VP8 and VP9 encode/decode, the generated generic runtime
dispatch/configuration headers, public libvpx headers, upstream attribution,
and a small SceneIO CMake target. Examples, tools, tests, sample media,
platform assembly, and build-system-only source trees are not stored.

Local integration changes:

- config/vpx_config.h selects MSVC spelling and platform macros when compiled
  by MSVC while retaining the generated generic GCC-compatible branch for
  GCC/AppleClang.
- CMakeLists.txt compiles the portable upstream C implementation with its
  native worker-thread support and requires the exact 155-source closure.
- Chromium reference files are renamed CHROMIUM_* to make their origin clear.

provenance record and SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256. Every closure file is recorded
in case-insensitive path order in SOURCE_MANIFEST.sha256.
